name: skillbox
description: The dependency-free core of the skillbox family. Fork a Claude Code conversation into a new session truncated at a chosen point and navigate the resulting fork tree; write settled research into ticket draft files using a fixed ticket structure, and implement a ticket, deciding what has an obvious answer and asking only for real decisions, and take the questions still open in a conversation one at a time, each explained in depth; prototype a page as several structurally different UI variants, switchable from a floating panel in the browser; record settled architecture decisions as ADRs, and settled domain terms in a glossary every session is held to; keep the repository’s SDDs true as the code changes, and add research and outside facts to a knowledge base beside them, with a Stop hook that checks both and a start-of-turn hook that keeps an index of each, and of the ADRs, current; find where a slow Node.js path spends its time, through a CPU profile recorded over the inspector port. Needs only Node.
